status_values.confirmed: The supplied information establishes an allergen is present.
status_values.not_identified: No regulated allergen has been established from the information provided. This does NOT mean allergen-free.
status_values.needs_checking: The ingredient is ambiguous, compound, conditional, or lacks sufficient specification to reach a conclusion.

soya_fully_refined_oil_exemption.source: Annex II EU FIC (retained UK law)
soya_fully_refined_oil_exemption.description: Only applies when the supplied information explicitly confirms that the soybean oil or fat is fully refined.

compound_ingredient_requires_subingredie.description: A manufactured compound ingredient may have its own ingredient list. The top-level name alone cannot always establish allergen status.

may_contain_cereal_carrier.description: Some raising agents and powders may contain cereal-derived carriers. Supplier information may be required.
